snippet.title: Romeo is a Dead Man - Announce Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Bask in the crimson-red catharsis of ultra-violent "bloody action" and dive into a completely unpredictable story. Witness the totally unhinged, all-new title from Grasshopper Manufacture! Coming to PlayStation®5.
